effective_noise_metric_contract.method: separate retained overlapping-window RMS exceedances from prospectively measured de-duplicated transient events
effective_noise_metric_contract.reference: digital full scale and prospectively frozen robust per-channel RMS-envelope baseline
effective_noise_metric_contract.units: dBFS-relative full scale, exceedance windows/s, distinct events/s
effective_noise_metric_contract.uncertainty: finite 15 s interval, 20 ms envelope, 100 ms gap bridge, uncontrolled room sources, and no calibrated SPL reference
effective_noise_metric_contract.aggregation: legacy window count/rate and RMS/spectrum summaries; prospective event count/rate, duration, peak, stationary, short, and boundary-censored diagnostics
effective_noise_metric_contract.exclusions: no evidence is deleted; inspected legacy recordings cannot confirm the prospective event detector
effective_noise_metric_contract.missing: absent prospective detector provenance or terminal new intended-silence evidence fails noise coverage
effective_noise_metric_contract.applicability: legacy RMS exceedance for retained silence/reference pre-stimulus intervals; prospective event rate only for s4_3_rob_silence_02_prospective_events_01
effective_noise_metric_contract.limitations: functional room-fixture-sensor noise only; not microphone self-noise SPL or a population event rate

expansion.stopping_effect: one terminal attempt completes the corrective metric cell and every outcome remains retained
